algorithm: { This algorithm is a sequential implementation of a Multistart Simulated Annealing algorithm, which iteratively starts at random points in the search space and performs local searches to find improved solutions. }

{**This implementation is a simple version of the CMA-ES (Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy) algorithm, which is an evolution strategy that adapts the covariance matrix of the normal distribution from which new candidates are sampled based on the performance of previous generations.**}
